newsitem.title: USA: Carolina Power to redeem some preferred.
newsitem.headline: Carolina Power to redeem some preferred.

text.p: Carolina Power & Light Co on Wednesday said it plans to redeem 850,000 shares of preferred stock for $101 per share.

The company said the plan calls for the redemption of all 500,000 shares of its serial preferred stock $7.72 series and all 350,000 shares of its serial preferred stock $7.95 series, on July 1. Carolina Power, an electric utility, said it will pay each holder of shares of these two series of serial preferred stock $101 per share.
Dividends on the stock will cease to accrue on the redemption date, it added.
Further, the company said, the usual quarterly dividends on the serial preferred stock will be paid in the regular manner on July 1 to shareholders of record as of June 18.
